dedupe_keys.name: wastewater treatment plant inflow rate network water levels and rain rate for koeln weiden germany

description: The depositor publishes a CSV of wastewater-treatment inflow, sewer-network water levels and rainfall at Koeln Weiden, Germany. Zenodo provides the file free under CC BY 4.0. Inflow is measured at the treatment plant, levels at multiple points in the sewer system, and rain at a recorder on the treatment-plant site. These paired observations can calibrate inflow-and-infiltration or wet-weather response in sewer simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this local collection. Coverage is one treatment catchment, not the full city sewer network. The landing-page description does not state observation dates, sample intervals, units or exact locations, so users must confirm those details from the CSV before quantitative reuse. It also cannot isolate rainfall-driven inflow without further assumptions. No CSV was downloaded, event aligned or mass balance checked.
